# Local map libraries

- 3d-force-graph 1.80.1, https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph — MIT, map-3d-force-graph-LICENSE.txt.
- three 0.186.1 core build, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js — MIT, map-three-LICENSE.txt.

Downloaded from the version-pinned jsDelivr npm package endpoints on 2026-10-09. The runtime uses these local copies. The graph library is its official standalone browser bundle; Three core provides the custom node meshes and label sprites.
